evidence: Audit of returned terminal output from existing six SD runs. Original target CSVs were not transferred or locally reanalyzed; figures retain printed precision. No new performance run. Cross-checks below compare terminal extracts only.
cohort_definition: planned arrivals in [2,18) seconds; all statuses and late outcomes retained
quantiles: nearest rank; no tail independence or confidence interval guarantee
phase_interpretation: request ID modulo 6 is an ordinal residue, not measured home pool, selected pool, callback pool or CPU
lag_interpretation: submitted_ns is the driver attempt before current request construction/root add. Lag cannot be attributed to execution of that current request. Shared driver CPU union, previous driver work, timer/wakeup, scheduler and run order remain unseparated.
overlap_interpretation: ALL request intervals clipped to wall window [2,18), including earlier arrivals and late outcomes. Scheduled overlap includes generator lag; attempt overlap includes request construction. Neither equals callback I, Folly Q/O, kernel runq, or whole-run RequestState peak_inflight. Faster completion naturally lowers overlap at equal arrival rate; this does not independently establish reduced contention as the cause.

descriptive_derived.interpretation: Descriptive conditional groups, not causal correction; no percentile subtraction.
Descriptive conditional groups, not causal correction; no percentile subtraction.

boundaries: One seed and one run per performance cell; this is another view of the same data, not an independent repetition.
The two home runs were first in the 4016 execution order; sequence/environment drift remains a confound.
Threshold 1 ms is a descriptive lag partition, not a scheduler pressure threshold.
Trace0 leaves callback load, placement, waits and cross-NUMA observations unavailable, not zero.
1537 clipped intervals per run is a wall-window interval count; the planned-arrival cohort remains 1536.
Whole-run RequestState peak 3 and wall-window attempt overlap peak 2 in candidate runs use different windows and lifecycle definitions; they are not contradictory.
No CPU or cluster blame is inferred from request residue; no causal performance correction is inferred from lag strata.
Current synthetic observations are not a production replay, a universal p99 predictor, or evidence for fixed four-pool deployment.

decision.bounded_arrival_audit: completed; no additional phase slicing, new trace, CPU matrix, pressure escalation or threshold search requested
decision.cpu_family_performance_expansion: frozen; retain 4016 latency benefit and CPU cost together, Q/O winner and production thread budget undecided
decision.engineering_priority: implement and functionally validate true external async completion and continuation; no completion claim is made in this evidence artifact
decision.mainline: one pool per verified hardware cluster, high-level total executor, request home plus ready callback placement, same NUMA preferred
